intro: An MCP server that keeps a C# solution compiled in memory and answers an agent faster than it loses the thread. The compiler, not text search, decides what a reference is, and the server never writes to your code: every refactoring returns edits for you to apply.
Call `load_solution` once, then pass the returned `solutionId` to everything else.
